hero.headline: LEARNING TECHNOLOGY AND IMPLEMENTATION
hero.description: I am an Implementation Consultant at Aptem, with earlier eLearning development experience at Relish Learning. I help clients use learning and employability platforms, understand their data, and turn requirements into practical solutions.
hero.framing: My background combines Articulate Storyline and SCORM, Power Query and OData reporting, UX, and teaching. I bring technical problem-solving and clear guidance to the way people learn and use software.
